scripts.dev:mock: npm run dev:mock:infra && npm run dev:mock:seed && npm run dev:mock:start
scripts.dev:mock:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis mock-soroban-rpc && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');let ok=false;for(let i=0;i<30;i++){try{execSync('docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U flowfi -d flowfi',{stdio:'ignore'});ok=true;break;}catch(_){}}if(!ok)throw new Error('Postgres did not become healthy in time')"
scripts.dev:mock:seed: cd backend && npm run prisma:generate && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://flowfi:flowfi_dev_password@localhost:5433/flowfi npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && cd .. && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://flowfi:flowfi_dev_password@localhost:5433/flowfi npx tsx scripts/seed-mock-data.ts
scripts.dev:mock:start:
echo "
✅  Mock sandbox ready — starting services...
  Backend:   http://localhost:3001
  Frontend:  http://localhost:3000
  API docs:  http://localhost:3001/api-docs
" && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "cd backend && SANDBOX_MODE_ENABLED=true SOROBAN_RPC_URL=http://localhost:8000 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://flowfi:flowfi_dev_password@localhost:5433/flowfi REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 npm run dev" "cd frontend && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev"
